Message:
drm/amdgpu: optimize fn gfx_v10_ring_insert_nop

Optimize gfx_v10_ring_insert_nop() to call
optimized version of amdgpu_ring_insert_nop
instead of calling amdgpu_ring_write for number
of nop times.
